description:
Cast Lightwheel Enhancements either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, adding {W}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.
